children.name: Citronella suaveolens  R.A.Howard
children.description: Ecology and phenology: — Citronella suaveolens inhabits various types of primary forests at elevations of 0 – 1600 m a. s. l. In the Song Thanh Nature Reserve, Vietnam, it is common in a primary, mid-mountain, weakly disturbed forest along rivers. A description of vegetation in this forest complex is provided by Vislobokov et al. (2019). Flowering in Vietnam: April – May.
